<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditService;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    protected $auditService;

    public function __construct(AuditService $auditService)
    {
        $this->auditService = $auditService;
    }

    /**
     * Handle user login attempts.
     * Logs authentication events for compliance (SOC2).
     */
    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $credentials = $request->validate([
            'email' => 'required|email|max:255',
            'password' => 'required|string|max:128',
        ]);

        $email = $request->input('email');
        $ipAddress = $request->header('X-Forwarded-For', $request->ip());
        $userAgent = $request->header('User-Agent', 'unknown');

        // Log the authentication attempt for audit trail
        Log::info("Authentication attempt for user: {$email} from IP: {$ipAddress} UA: {$userAgent}");

        if (auth()->attempt($credentials)) {
            $user = auth()->user();
            $this->auditService->recordLogin($user, $ipAddress);
            
            Log::info("Successful login for user: {$email} from IP: {$ipAddress}");
            
            return response()->json([
                'token' => $user->createToken('api-token')->plainTextToken,
                'user' => $user->only(['id', 'name', 'email'])
            ]);
        }

        Log::warning("Failed login attempt for user: {$email} from IP: {$ipAddress} UA: {$userAgent}");

        return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid credentials'], 401);
    }

    /**
     * Handle password reset requests.
     */
    public function requestPasswordReset(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['email' => 'required|email|max:255']);
        
        $email = $request->input('email');
        $source = $request->header('X-Request-Source', 'web');
        
        Log::info("Password reset requested for: {$email} via source: {$source}");

        // Rate limiting handled by middleware
        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();
        
        if ($user) {
            $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            $user->password_reset_token = hash('sha256', $token);
            $user->password_reset_expires = now()->addHour();
            $user->save();
            
            // Queue email dispatch
            dispatch(new \App\Jobs\SendPasswordResetEmail($user, $token));
        }

        // Always return success to prevent user enumeration
        return response()->json(['message' => 'If the email exists, a reset link has been sent.']);
    }

    /**
     * Logout and revoke current token.
     */
    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $ipAddress = $request->header('X-Forwarded-For', $request->ip());
        
        Log::info("User logout: {$user->email} from IP: {$ipAddress}");
        
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
        
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Logged out successfully']);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application deployed on EC2 instances in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20). The service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to principals within the organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The NLB target group health checks use TCP on port 443. There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway egress path for the application subnet, and the VPC endpoint's security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) only permits inbound TCP/443 from CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. Route tables for the private subnet contain only local VPC routes and the VPC endpoint prefix list. DNS resolution for the service uses the private hosted zone associated with the endpoint (auth-api.internal.corp.example.com resolves to ENI IPs within the VPC). CloudWatch Logs agent streams logs with a subscription filter, but no log sanitization is applied at the application layer.

config.route_table: local routes only (10.0.0.0/16), pl-xxx for S3/DynamoDB endpoints
config.dns: Private hosted zone: auth-api.internal.corp.example.com -> VPC endpoint ENIs
config.load_balancer: Internal NLB, no public IP, target group in private subnet
config.log_destination: CloudWatch Logs via agent, no sanitization
